items.title: Pre-launch signals.
items.summary: @scaling01 posted “happy Haiku 5.5 day” before the announcement. @kimmonismus said the model had already appeared in a Claude Code update and predicted “Luna-pricing.” He then posted the pricing ahead of the official post ( @kimmonismus ) and confirmed when it…

items.title: Official launch.
items.summary: @claudeai and @AnthropicAI called it “the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we’ve ever released,” costing about 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 on average.

items.title: Availability and intended use.
items.summary: It is live on the Claude Platform and in Claude Code ( @ClaudeDevs ). Anthropic positions it as a subagent paired with Opus 5.5 or Sonnet 5.5, for high-volume, cost-sensitive work such as summaries, compactions and database queries.

items.title: Sonnet 5.5 price cut.
items.summary: Cache reads were halved from $0.20 to $0.10 per 1M tokens. Anthropic says this makes Sonnet 5.5 about 20% cheaper on most long-running or agentic work ( @claudeai ).

items.title: API credits for subscribers.
items.summary: Monthly Claude Platform API credits now come with Max 5x ($100), Max 20x ($200) and Team (up to $500, pooled). They work on any model, including Haiku 5.5, and in third-party harnesses ( @ClaudeDevs ).

items.title: Same-day SDK update.
items.summary: Computer-use and browser-use toolsets are now built into the Python and TypeScript Claude SDKs. The SDK runs the action loop and sends clicks and keystrokes to drivers from browser_use, Browserbase, E2B or Daytona, so developers no longer write that loop thems…

items.title: Partner rollouts on day one:
items.summary: Cursor: @cursor_ai claims “10x less than Haiku 4.5” on shorter requests and published CursorBench comparisons ( @cursor_ai ).
